name: password-manager
description: Local-first Windows password manager built with Tauri, Rust, React, and SQLite.
author: lugep

scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.build:tauri: npm run build:web && cargo build --release -p cipher-vault
scripts.test:web: npm run build:web && node --import tsx --test tests/web-session.test.mjs tests/renderer-policy.test.mjs
scripts.test:tauri-shell: npm run build:web && cargo build -p cipher-vault --features e2e && node scripts/verify-tauri-shell.mjs target/debug/cipher-vault.exe target/e2e-screenshots
